en.headline: FLOCKFEST craft beer and music festival opens at PMQ this weekend
en.dek: Black Kite Brewery hosts eight Hong Kong and Japanese breweries, indie live sets and local food at the Central courtyard from Friday to Sunday, with free admission.
body: FLOCKFEST 2026, a three-day craft beer and music festival organised by Black Kite Brewery, will take place at the courtyard and marketplace of PMQ in Central from 11 to 13 September.

Eight breweries from Hong Kong and Japan will pour more than 50 beers across 20 taps, including eight limited collaboration beers. Local food vendors and live performances by Hong Kong indie artists form part of the programme.

Admission is free. Opening hours are 5pm to 10pm on Friday, noon to 10pm on Saturday and noon to 5pm on Sunday. Drink and merchandise packages are available for purchase. The organisers said the event is cashless.

zh.headline: FLOCKFEST精釀啤酒音樂節本周末PMQ舉行
zh.dek: 黑鳶啤酒於中環元創方廣場舉辦為期三天的精釀啤酒與獨立音樂節，匯聚港日八間酒廠，免費入場。
body: 由黑鳶啤酒舉辦的FLOCKFEST 2026精釀啤酒音樂節，將於9月11日至13日在中環元創方地面廣場及市集舉行。
活動匯聚香港及日本共八間酒廠，設20個龍頭供應逾50款啤酒，包括八款限量聯乘啤酒。現場亦有本地美食及香港獨立音樂人現場演出。
入場免費。開放時間為周五下午5時至晚上10時、周六中午12時至晚上10時、周日中午12時至下午5時。飲品及周邊商品套票可另行購買。主辦單位表示活動為無現金交易。
